proves.claim: The full sweepClaims path releases a lapsed claim held only by a stalled test waiter, keeping its handoff pin and commit, with the release table off and on.

health.io-stale-state.sweep-releases-sta.why: #12690 proved capture alone; this proves the sweep's own ordered move accepts the release, so the waiter's renewals cannot keep a dead claim alive.

proves.claim: The full sweepClaims path keeps a lapsed claim that has a gate job, a progressing test job or a recent event from its seat.

health.io-stale-state.sweep-keeps-live-c.why: Without it the release of stalled waiters could take a claim whose holder is really working.
